normalized.paraphrased captions and stylized video: paraphrased video captions, stylized video frames

changes_made.explanation: Added Instruct-Pix2Pix as it's explicitly mentioned as an alternative visual generation model. Split the combined output description into separate items for clarity.
No automatic NLG evaluation metrics are used. The paper evaluates retrieval performance using recall metrics, but these are not evaluating the quality of the generated text/video content itself.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate the generated outputs. LLMs are only used for generating paraphrased text.
No human evaluation of the generated outputs is conducted. The paper only shows qualitative examples but doesn't report systematic human evaluation results.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on video-text retrieval using data augmentation rather than traditional NLG evaluation. While it generates text (paraphrases) and visual content, the evaluation is entirely on retrieval performance metrics (Recall@K, MdR, MnR) rather than quality assessment of the generated content itself.
